name: blockwork
description: Edit Gutenberg in an active editor or a background document, including selections, annotations, settings, shared entities, media, and terms. Uses the internal app browser by default.

interface.longDescription: Ask the agent to edit pages and posts on your WordPress site in plain language. Blockwork makes each change in the block editor inside the app's browser, using WordPress's own editing code, so pages come out as if a person had made them and you can keep editing them by hand. It edits a page you have open and leaves the changes for you to review, or opens one in the background and saves it. It also changes post settings, media, categories, and tags, and it keeps a page's status unless you ask to change it.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Blockwork to inspect the block editor for a page on my WordPress site.
